content_text:
Hi Roger,
Curious to know how much you believe your work in still photography (and indeed influences from other still photographers whom you admire) have influenced your cinematographic tastes and practices?
Would you advocate for stills photography as a training ground (and room for experimentation) for filmmakers? And are there photographers whose work you would particularly recommend studying?
Thanks!
Duncan
